response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong technical expertise in developer tools, testing infrastructure, and full-stack development, with notable contributions to open-source projects and hands-on experience in build systems and automation. While his people-management experience is limited, his technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration align well with the role's requirements.
strengths: Extensive experience in developer tools, testing frameworks, and automation (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial).
Proven technical leadership in open-source projects and cross-functional teams (e.g., workshops, talks, and contributions to AI-agent infrastructure).
Diverse technical stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, Kubernetes) with hands-on coding in complex systems (e.g., low-latency microservices, mobile platforms).
concerns: Limited explicit people-management experience (only 1-2 years inferred from team leadership roles).
No direct mobile-platform ecosystem experience (though adjacent skills in build systems and testing apply).
Lacks formal education in computer science (Bachelor's in Photography/Video may not fully align with preferred qualifications).
